tools.name: infer_schema
tools.description: Infer flat schema from a bounded local CSV/JSON/JSONL file.
tools.prerequisites: Explicit permission to read the source; remote upload also needs permission to transmit it
tools.outputs: Upload identity/fingerprint or bounded inferred schema
tools.retry: Uploads create new identities; reuse the successful upload rather than uploading again

tools.name: map_to_schema
tools.description: Propose correspondence; strict JSON strings preserve decimal precision.
tools.prerequisites: Owned source plus explicit target rules/decisions
tools.outputs: Unapproved proposal, version or sampled preview; not approval or full validation
tools.approval: Do not infer business meanings; obtain missing decisions
tools.retry: Reads/previews may repeat; saved drafts/versions can create new identities

tools.name: review_mapping
tools.description: Inspect exact proposal, evidence, alternatives and approval state.
tools.prerequisites: Exact proposed/approved mapping, explicit target/source and matching scope where required
tools.outputs: Validation/review/drift report; stop on unsupported or mismatched inputs
tools.approval: Read access within the user's task
tools.retry: Safe to repeat unchanged validation; changed decisions need review

tools.name: resolve_mapping
tools.description: Explicit target:source decisions; null skips an optional target.
tools.prerequisites: Owned source plus explicit target rules/decisions
tools.outputs: Unapproved proposal, version or sampled preview; not approval or full validation
tools.approval: Do not infer business meanings; obtain missing decisions
tools.retry: Reads/previews may repeat; saved drafts/versions can create new identities

tools.name: approve_mapping
tools.description: Record user-authorized review of an exact mapping for a named scope.
tools.prerequisites: Exact reviewed hash/fingerprint and scope, with all unresolved choices settled
tools.outputs: Approval bound to that exact version
tools.approval: Explicit authorized reviewer approval; fixture permission covers only owned fixtures
tools.retry: Reuse only the same reviewed version and scope; edits invalidate approval

tools.name: validate_schema_mapping
tools.description: Check schema, completeness, exact fingerprints, decisions and approval.
tools.prerequisites: Exact proposed/approved mapping, explicit target/source and matching scope where required
tools.outputs: Validation/review/drift report; stop on unsupported or mismatched inputs
tools.approval: Read access within the user's task
tools.retry: Safe to repeat unchanged validation; changed decisions need review

tools.name: check_schema_drift
tools.description: Compare a local input schema against approved scope and schema version.
tools.prerequisites: Exact proposed/approved mapping, explicit target/source and matching scope where required
tools.outputs: Validation/review/drift report; stop on unsupported or mismatched inputs
tools.approval: Read access within the user's task
tools.retry: Safe to repeat unchanged validation; changed decisions need review

tools.name: transform_file
tools.description: Transform an approved local snapshot; return exact JSON and receipt.
tools.prerequisites: Reviewed approved mapping with matching fingerprint/scope; validate first
tools.outputs: Exact transformed records and receipt, or matching-runtime Python wrapper text; MCP does not save an output file
tools.approval: Explicit mapping approval and read access; saving output or executing a generated wrapper requires its own authorization
tools.retry: Repeat only for the same approved mapping and scope; the caller must deliberately save returned data if requested

tools.name: generate_transformation
tools.description: Emit approved runtime-dependent Python; never executes supplied code.
tools.prerequisites: Reviewed approved mapping with matching fingerprint/scope; validate first
tools.outputs: Exact transformed records and receipt, or matching-runtime Python wrapper text; MCP does not save an output file
tools.approval: Explicit mapping approval and read access; saving output or executing a generated wrapper requires its own authorization
tools.retry: Repeat only for the same approved mapping and scope; the caller must deliberately save returned data if requested
